refusal.layout: one int32 failure flag per distinct source/field cause plus a separate zeroed uint64 index workspace
refusal.source_id: pinned source line number; nonzero only on refusal
refusal.record_conversion: After synchronization, for each nonzero int32 flag, combine the mapped source_id and field_id with failure_detail[slot]-1 to form the host AdFailureRecord.
refusal.ordering: integer atomicOr for flags and integer atomicMax for element details; deterministic under concurrent refusals

reduction.order: Repeated fixed 256-thread binary trees; grid=ceil(n/512); use disjoint input/output buffers, then add the sole result to each parameter cotangent in one thread.
reduction.required_integration: Load the two auxiliary symbols from the adjoint cubin and schedule all passes after __ad on the same stream.

alias_contract: Forward fields use the disjoint default ABI; output seed and input cotangent storage are separate. The overwritten baseline is not read by the forward.
bounds_contract: Host validates nlev, ncells, nspecies, 0 <= nsolve <= ncells, signed-index products and all input and output capacities.
floating_policy: Tested strict route: compile derivative with --fmad=false --ftz=false --prec-div=true; the recorded strict forward uses --ftz=false. Arithmetic is differentiated mathematically and nonfinite values and zero denominators refuse the gradient. At integration the derivative denormal mode must match the forward image; fast mode uses --ftz=true. Fast-route derivative and compiled-out helper branch recording have not been verified by this task.
verification_status: Corrected int32 refusal ABI; two convection_permitting captured-step v5 dot tests and bitwise reverse checks passed. Taylor and proof-of-record status are recorded in the task receipt.
